voice.summary: Sounds like a puzzle that wants to be played again: short, friendly and slightly smug about a good merge. Instructions fit in one line and wins are celebrated softly.
dos: Explain the rules in one sentence
Use verbs like slide, merge and spawn

boilerplate: Tilesum is a sliding-tile number puzzle where equal tiles merge into larger ones, played with arrow keys or swipes on a responsive board with undo, scores and best-score tracking.

microcopy.error: No moves left. Start a new game.

logo.note: A tile grid is the game board in its simplest form.
